missing_policy: complete required per score, otherwise null; product convention (source instructions: omits coded as zero/missing; large omissions invalidate the test; not adopted)
source_note: Functional (reverse-keyed) items per the official Beck Institute DAS scoring table, FORM B columns: items 1/5/12/30/14/33/19/36/20/26 scored in ascending order (totally agree = 1); the remaining 30 dysfunctional items scored descending (totally agree = 7). Total = sum of all 40 (40-280); higher = more dysfunctional attitudes. Items #12 and #30 are listed as functional in BOTH Form A and Form B (parallel forms are not fully disjoint). Form A is registered separately as dasa40@1.0.0; the two forms are parallel versions of one family and their scores are not interchangeable.
